summary: Stripe billing runtime validation passed for checkout authorization, sales-led plan boundary, webhook verification, idempotency, subscription synchronization, entitlements and billing audit logging.
controlsVerified: Checkout requires authenticated user, organization context, manage_billing permission, trusted mutation, rate limit and step-up verification.
Checkout uses server-side plan normalization and Stripe price mapping instead of client supplied prices.
Starter and Growth are self-serve checkout plans while Enterprise is excluded from self-serve checkout.
Billing portal requires authenticated user, organization context, manage_billing permission, trusted mutation and step-up verification.
Billing portal return path is constrained to the organization billing dashboard.
Webhook routes validate provider signature from the raw request body before processing events.
Webhook events are claimed idempotently before subscription mutation.
Subscription created, updated and deleted events sync status and entitlements into Supabase.
Payment failure handling does not grant new entitlement access and creates billing audit visibility.
